description: This file defines the entity class `ScheduledJobDetail` which models scheduled job details within the application. It includes fields for job properties such as name, cron expression, status flags, timestamps, and grouping, along with an update method that modifies the entity based on a `JsonCommand` input.

classes.name: ScheduledJobDetail
classes.description: Entity class representing scheduled job details, with properties for job identifiers, scheduling info, status flags, timestamps, and a method to update its properties based on external commands.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Updates the `ScheduledJobDetail` instance's properties based on a `JsonCommand`, tracking actual changes in a map.
